title: Muslim: Prayer, Qibla Finder
description:
Embark on an enriching journey of faith with the "Muslim: Prayer, Qibla, Quran" app, your comprehensive companion for navigating the intricacies of Islamic life. Designed to seamlessly integrate into your daily routine, this app offers an extensive array of features tailored to enhance your spiritual practices and deepen your connection with Allah.

Prayer times and prayer alarm feature;
Never miss a moment of prayer with our precise Azan alarm feature, meticulously curated to align with your prayer schedule. Receive customizable notifications for Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha'a prayers, ensuring you remain steadfast in your devotion regardless of your location or schedule. Stay on track and prioritize your spiritual obligations with ease, knowing that your prayer commitments are always at the forefront.

Qibla finder, compass feature;
Navigate the path of devotion with confidence using our intuitive Qibla finder feature. Whether you're traveling to unfamiliar destinations or simply seeking guidance in your local surroundings, our Qibla compass provides accurate direction towards the Kaaba in Mecca. Enhance the accuracy and sincerity of your prayers by ensuring that you face the Qibla with certainty, fostering a deeper connection to the sacred sanctuary of Islam.

Religious knowledge;
Delve into the profound wisdom of the Holy Quran with our comprehensive Quran feature, offering access to the complete text alongside translations in multiple languages. Immerse yourself in the divine teachings of the Quran through immersive audio recitations, bookmarks, notes, and daily reminders, empowering you to embody its timeless lessons in your daily life. Strengthen your understanding and appreciation of the Quranic verses, enriching your spiritual journey with profound insights and guidance.

Explore the noble teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) with our extensive Hadith collection, offering a wealth of guidance on various aspects of life. Engage with the timeless wisdom of the Hadiths, discovering practical solutions and moral principles that resonate with the challenges of modern living. Empower yourself to emulate the exemplary character of the Prophet, embodying compassion, humility, and righteousness in all your endeavors.

Counter feature;
Cultivate mindfulness and spiritual discipline with our Dhikr counter feature, allowing you to track your daily remembrance of Allah with ease and precision. Set personalized targets, monitor your progress, and engage in common dhikr practices, fostering a deeper connection to the divine and nurturing inner peace and tranquility.

Islamic assistant for Ramadan.
Embrace the spirit of Ramadan with specialized features tailored to support your fasting journey, including Iftar and Sahur reminders, as well as Tarawih prayer times. Experience the blessings and rewards of Ramadan with enhanced spiritual support and guidance, ensuring a fulfilling and transformative experience during the holiest month of the Islamic calendar.

Share the blessings of this transformative app with your loved ones, spreading the joy and beauty of Islam with friends and family. Strengthen your bonds of faith and community as you embark on a collective journey of spiritual growth and enlightenment, united in your pursuit of divine guidance and righteousness.

Download "Muslim: Prayer, Qibla, Quran" from the Google Play Store today and unlock a world of spiritual enrichment and fulfillment. Join countless Muslims around the globe who have made it their #1 choice for navigating the complexities of Islamic life with confidence and devotion. Download now and experience the ultimate Muslim assistant, empowering you to live your faith to the fullest. Experience the convenience of Azan alarm, accurate prayer times, and Qibla finder, all in one app.
